normalization.access: Read original private Minecraft.fontManager field through reflection; invoke its unchanged public method
normalization.timing: Once on the render thread immediately before gui.setScreen(new ControlsScreen()), after game loading finishes and loading overlay disappears
normalization.effect: Original FontSet.reload(Set) resets textures and glyph caches and selects the same already loaded providers using the same current font options

caseOrder: Cases remain in frozen cases.json order; four non-overlapping rows per page at y16/80/144/208

glyphObservation.timing: No UV observation is required or performed for these integral original ASCII bitmap glyphs; the inherited observer hook is enabled in runOne and disabled in runTwo
glyphObservation.samplingAuthority: Original unchanged ASCII PNG binary alpha masks, original bitmap advances; SVG rects compared to original native output

scope: Original Minecraft font renderer and assets only. This normalizes startup/title/splash texture history; it does not replace glyphs, styles, metrics or the renderer.
